problem_statement: TimestampSigner and TimedSerializer must normalize an invalid-signature token with an out-of-range timestamp to BadTimeSignature instead of leaking ValueError or OSError from datetime conversion. Preserve decoded payload metadata and date_signed=None for this malformed timestamp; validate must return False and loads_unsafe must report invalid while recovering a decodable payload. Preserve ordinary timed round-trips, normal invalid-signature timestamp metadata and age expiry. No particular exception message is required.
